name: Sky130 Crypto Rot
description: Crypto root of trust (AES, SHA-256, key ladder, DRBG) on sky130 — 2AM Logic canary block

rows.target: AES-128, encrypt + decrypt, one round per cycle
SP 800-108 counter-mode KDF on HMAC-SHA-256, 4 derived slots
CTR_DRBG (AES-128, derivation function), seeded and reseeded from `sky130-trng`'s conditioned output

rows.parameter: Clock (all sky130_fd_sc_hd corners; setup binds at `ss_100C_1v60`)

rows.target: numbered properties in [`spec/key-isolation-properties.md`](spec/key-isolation-properties.md), re-proven on the synthesized netlist where marked
